subject: Food Science
title: Safe Food Handling at Home
description: A quick win: understand Safe Food Handling at Home.

hook.text: 48 million Americans get food poisoning yearly. Most cases happen not in restaurants, but in their own kitchens.

buildup.text: Four rules dominate home food safety: clean, separate, cook, and chill. They prevent 90% of domestic foodborne illness.

discovery.text: Internal temperature is the only reliable indicator of doneness. Color and time are unreliable—thermometers are essential.

twist.text: Thawing meat on the counter is unsafe—the surface reaches danger-zone temperatures while the center is still frozen.

climax.text: Safe thawing methods: refrigerator (slow), cold running water (medium), or microwave (fast). Never the counter.

punchline.text: Clean, separate, cook, chill. Four words that prevent millions of illnesses.

quiz.question: Why is thawing meat on the counter unsafe?
options: The surface reaches danger-zone temperatures while the center stays frozen
